notes: Procurement is focused on predictable unit economics — cannot accept open-ended spur-of-the-moment scaling costs.

sla_summary: Requested uptime tiers: 99.95% core business hours, 99.9% off-hours
Credit schedule: hourly-aware credits, 5% per hour beyond SLA up to 12 hours, escalation clauses at 24/48 hours
Maintenance: monthly 2-hour window preferred with 14-day advance notification; emergency patches allowed with post-mortem
Support: P1 ack <1h, P1 mitigation <4h; 24/7 on-call for top-tier incidents after GA; named on-call for first 90 days
Measurement & reporting: hourly availability logs + token-level latency histograms delivered to Redwood Console and shared dashboard
Penalty caps: negotiation point — they want uncapped operational credits up to ARR offset after 48h cumulative downtime (Redwood to propose cap), termination rights on repeated SLA misses
